title: AI Business Automation & Process Optimization
summary: Replace manual operational labor with zero-hallucination document extraction pipelines, CRM enrichment, and automated workflows.

problem.headline: Manual Ops Labor & Fragile Zapier Hacks
points: Manual tasks (invoices, lead qualification, support routing) burning hundreds of operational hours.
Fragile low-code Zapier hacks failing silently and producing hallucinated data.
Unmanaged AI integrations lacking audit trails and human-in-the-loop fallback bounds.

approach.headline: Zod-Validated AI Pipelines & Direct CRM Integration
points: Enforce strict Zod schemas for all AI outputs and tool calls to eliminate unformatted responses.
Connect AI pipelines directly to existing business software (HubSpot, Slack, Postgres, email).
Route low-confidence tasks to human review while recording complete execution logs.

deliverables: Production-ready AI Business Process Automation Pipeline
Direct CRM, Slack, and Database API Integrations
Operations Dashboard & Append-Only Execution Audit Log
